C1384.title: Supply-Chain Tampering Risk in the Lebanon Pager Explosions
C1384.summary: On September 17, 2024, pagers used by Hezbollah members exploded across Lebanon, killing 12 people and injuring nearly 3,000 in the first wave; walkie-talkie explosions followed the next day. United Nations and Reuters reporting documented the two waves of device explosions and casualties. Reporting and expert analysis connected the incident to communication-device supply-chain security risks, showing that tampering with device procurement, delivery, or use chains can cause serious physical harm.
